First, note the date format given is MM-DD-YYYY: 03-15-1006.  
Subtract 24 weeks and 1 day = 24×7 + 1 = 169 days.  

169 days before 03-15-1006:  
1006 is not a leap year (divisible by 2 but not by 4).  
March 15 is day 74 of the year (31+28+15).  
74 − 169 = −95 days → go into previous year 1005.  
1005 is not a leap year (not divisible by 4).  
Days in 1005: 365.  
365 − 95 = 270th day of 1005.  

270th day:  
Jan 31 → 31  
Feb 28 → 59  
Mar 31 → 90  
Apr 30 → 120  
May 31 → 151  
Jun 30 → 181  
Jul 31 → 212  
Aug 31 → 243  
Sep 30 → 273 → 270 is Sep 27 (since 273 − 3 = 270).  

So date is 1005-09-27.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1005-09-27
